fresh_garmin_evidence.recent_load: One 173.2-minute hike with Garmin load 51.2 and zero MTB sessions in the preceding seven days.

coach_interpretation.verdict: Clear the conditional two-cycle Enduro contract, subject to the car-park opening gate, first-cycle admission gate and live weather gates.
coach_interpretation.garmin_arbitration: Garmin Recovery with LOW ACWR reflects a very low recent acute stimulus rather than overload. It caps intensity, novelty and extension but does not justify replacing the explicit bounded familiar Enduro session with 45 minutes indoors when physical readiness is green, CNS is ready and the athlete reports full sharpness.
coach_interpretation.weather: The 13:30 METMalaysia warning did not include Kuala Lumpur, but the Kuala Lumpur district forecast retained isolated-thunderstorm risk. Recheck warning, radar and sky before rollout and before cycle two; thunder or lightning blocks or ends MTB.
coach_interpretation.dose_ceiling: Enduro bike on unchanged stable setup; two earned Twin Peaks-to-Pure-Quill cycles, 120-150 minutes maximum, no third or bonus descent.

route_and_laps.lap_1: First Twin Peaks climb; athlete-reported RPE 5 despite deliberately easy pacing.
route_and_laps.lap_2: Pure Quill at approximately 65 percent while reacquainting with the Enduro bike.
route_and_laps.lap_3: Second Twin Peaks climb; athlete-reported RPE 4, with clarity restored and the effort feeling easier.
route_and_laps.lap_4: Pure Quill at approximately 75 percent with improved braking and authoritative front-wheel loading.
route_and_laps.lap_6: Approximately half of the DH Line used as the final-stage egress descent.

reported_context.upper_body_response: Some stiffness that improved as ride time accumulated; upper-body fatigue was 3/10.

fueling_totals.contents: 1 L 100Plus Active plus three 15 g honey sachets
fueling_totals.basis: Athlete-supplied product values preserved in coaching memory: 48 g carbohydrate and 430 mg sodium per litre of 100Plus Active; 11.3 g carbohydrate and 4.4 mg sodium per honey sachet.

session_contract_review.right_knee_gate_and_ride_response: passed; no right-knee issue or pain reported
session_contract_review.bike_and_setup: Garmin Gear confirms S-Works Enduro MY25; athlete explicitly confirmed the suspension and bike setup was unchanged. Pedal system was clipless.
session_contract_review.pedal_feel: natural and possibly slightly more comfortable than flat pedals
descent_intent_by_loop: approximately 65 percent and cautious while reacquainting with the Enduro
session_contract_review.known_exit_recognition: All expected exits were recognized; no exit was missed.
session_contract_review.front_tracking_and_intended_steering: Authoritative front-wheel loading with no unintended deflection or left pull.
session_contract_review.reactive_braking_or_rescue: None; no reactive braking, rescue correction or near miss.
session_contract_review.fork_ping_or_pack_down: Fork behaved as expected with no abnormal behavior reported.
session_contract_review.rear_kick_wallow_or_pitch: Rear behaved as expected with no abnormal behavior reported.
session_contract_review.vision_and_decision_speed_first_vs_final: Cycle 1 processing was slower than cycle 2. Cycle 2 vision and decision speed reached approximately 90 percent of Clayton's normal full-speed Enduro level, not 90 percent RPE or descent intent. Clayton does not yet feel 100 percent reacclimated to Enduro speed and bike timing after a 57-day gap since the last Gear-confirmed Enduro ride on 2026-06-12.
session_contract_review.technical_quality_notes: Lap 2 was a cautious 65-percent Enduro reacquaintance run. Lap 4 remained a 75-percent riding-intent run and showed improved braking, authoritative front-wheel loading, no missed exit, no deflection or left pull, no reactive braking, no rescue correction, no near miss, and expected fork and rear behavior. Clipless felt natural and possibly slightly more comfortable than flat pedals. Because both laps used clipless, the within-session improvement remains rider reacclimation rather than a pedal A/B effect. Cycle 2 processing improved to approximately 90 percent of Clayton's normal full-speed Enduro level but was not yet fully restored.
session_contract_review.late_session_skill_fade: none; cycle 2 processing improved rather than faded, while remaining approximately 90 percent of Clayton's normal Enduro level

coach_contract_audit.action_alignment_notes: Modality, bike, session count, two-cycle structure, route family, second-descent intent and maximum-cycle cap aligned. The first dry descent was deliberately downshifted to 65 percent, total duration finished 10.2 minutes below the written 120-minute lower bound, and cycle two was started even though the first climb RPE 5 did not satisfy the written RPE-4-or-lower admission gate.
coach_contract_audit.load_alignment: actual Garmin load 242.5 versus expected 123.8 and expected range 86.6-167.1; actual was 45.1 percent above the predicted upper bound
coach_contract_audit.cross_date_equipment_caveat: The 2026-06-12 four-cycle Enduro comparison used flat pedals, whereas 2026-08-08 used clipless. June remains valid capacity/load context but is not a pedal-system-matched technical comparison.
coach_contract_audit.calibration_disposition: The MTB technical outcome is clean but processing was only approximately 90 percent of Clayton's normal Enduro level. Actual load is not a physiology-only match, and the cycle-two admission-gate mismatch prevents nominal true digital-twin calibration. The next-morning response remains necessary for progression and recovery interpretation, not to rescue calibration eligibility.

reported_context.technical_incidents: No missed exit, unintended deflection, reactive braking, rescue correction or near miss.
reported_context.vision_and_decision_speed: Cycle 1 was slower than cycle 2. Cycle 2 reached approximately 90 percent of Clayton's normal full-speed Enduro vision and decision speed; 90 percent does not refer to RPE or riding-intent percentage.
reported_context.enduro_reacclimation: Clayton does not yet feel 100 percent reacclimated to Enduro speed and bike timing after not riding the Enduro for roughly one to two months. Garmin Gear history confirms a 57-day gap since 2026-06-12.

pedal_comparison.athlete_feel: Clipless already felt natural and possibly slightly more comfortable than flat pedals.
